_comment: Leg manifest for harness/orchestrate.ps1. Adding a leg is DATA, not a new dispatcher script. The orchestrator owns: dependency gating, worktree creation, trust, launch, receipt monitoring, branch backup, and notification - in ONE window. Supersedes run_relay.ps1, run_solaris_repair.ps1, run_repair_heats.ps1, run_followon.ps1, heartbeat.ps1 and watch_relay.ps1.
_effort_note: VERIFIED 2026-07-26 by negative control: 'claude --effort banana' warns 'Unknown --effort value, ignoring it' and lists low/medium/high/xhigh/max. 'ultracode' produces NO warning, so it is recognised despite being absent from --help. Acceptance alone would have proved nothing - a silently-ignored flag returns OK exactly like an applied one.

legs.note: Queued 2026-07-25, NEVER DISPATCHED - its brief was written into SYNAPSE_REPAIR_HEATS.md section 8 instead of this manifest, and the orchestrator reads the manifest. The panel renders TWO accent blues: t.SIGNAL #00D4FF at 11 sites, _ds.SIGNAL #8FB3D9 at 21. Mile 7 converted 20 of 31 AT THE CALL SITES, leaving both modules declaring SIGNAL. Resolve at the SOURCE. Now runnable because RES/R30 gave the panel a test surface for the first time. v3 design study explicitly OUT of scope.

legs.name: h22 compat
legs.note: R59. dir() says a symbol EXISTS; it cannot say DEPRECATED. Cross-references every hou.* SYNAPSE touches against the H22 reference and classifies it OK / DECAY_CLOCK / PRIVATE_API / PHANTOM. karmarenderproperties is deprecated and emitted in 11+ places while every live probe reported it healthy. Read-only, disjoint from H1/H2, gated on nothing.

legs.name: substrate truth
legs.note: R64. moneta_available() is one boolean carrying five independent claims: imports / same-module-both-interpreters / schema registered / prims authored typed / round-trips. Only the first is measured. MonetaMemory is concreteTyped and codegen'd, but the brief says prims are still untyped def - expected live state is registered=True in_use=False, the only cell that looks like success. Writes moneta_runtime.py so NOT read-only.

legs.name: compat re-adjudicate
legs.note: R72. H5 returned UNVERIFIABLE:1267 - partly a REACHABILITY artifact, since the pinned docs tree is ROBOTS_DISALLOWED and the unpinned one serves 21.0. Two local version-pinned sources exist: hom.zip (HOM axis, authoritative, control-passed) and the help cache (node axis, second source only). Adds the doc_silent_deprecation cell: runtime deprecated, authored help silent - karmarenderproperties and karma are its first members. deps H6 so nothing running is interrupted.

legs.name: ruling audit
legs.note: 78 rulings, one author, no second reader - the only control this repo has systematically failed to apply, and the document's own most-repeated finding is that an instrument checking its own work reports healthy while proving nothing. Applies the document's laws TO the document. POSITIVE CONTROL: R48/R64/R58/R15 are known-wrong; if the method does not independently catch all four it is broken. Read-only, disjoint from H7, runs in parallel.

legs.name: integrate
legs.note: merge, housekeep, prune worktrees. Runs LAST - gated on every evidence-producing leg so integration never merges a picture that is still moving.

legs.name: doc grounding
legs.note: LOP grounding 18%, COP 6% - both D2-shaped gaps. nodes.zip ships with 22.0.368: 5,034 pages, lop/ 198 at median 4,376B, cop/+cop2/ 525 at median ~2,900B. Measured coverage LOP 179/198=90%, COP 460/491=94%. Harvests to a NEW tier VERIFIED-DOC, reported SEPARATELY from probe-derived grounding - docs supply D2 and cannot supply D3, and karmarenderproperties proves docs go silent (69,921 chars, never mentions its own deprecation). Produces the corpus; wiring it is a separate decision.

legs.name: provenance union
legs.note: R91. R64 specified five fields and said moneta_provenance() would compose; the CTO then dispatched LEDGER and H6 as two independent legs, both deps:[], both rewriting that function from the same base. Neither has all five. LEDGER's 2,012 insertions are stranded at eb25abe and R52-R55 are DECIDED but un-shipped. This is AUTHORING, not merge resolution - no strategy produces a five-field function.

legs.name: retina m2 reconcile
legs.note: archive/retina-m2-orphan carries 1,966 lines on no other branch - found in a workflow worktree nothing was backing up, preserved minutes before pruning. Verdict only: does it merge, does its 15/15 T0 byte-identity claim hold, does the worker venv it names actually exist. R91 precedent: building on unmerged work is how four decided rulings got stranded.

legs.name: capture probe
legs.note: READ-ONLY. What capture verbs exist live on 22.0.368, can Karma emit an integer object-ID AOV, what does one capture cost, is the denoiser controllable. The ID-AOV answer gates the whole harness - no per-pixel prim identity means no mask means no 'only X changed'. Same shape as H3a, which is why the SideFX ask was correct rather than embarrassing.

legs.name: claim census
legs.note: The positioning document says 'a technical evaluator will open the repo'. This is that evaluator, run internally first. Four SHIPPING claims, each gets a producer path or NONE. Roadmap items exempt - they are honest by construction. Records AGE: claim 3 became defensible on 2026-07-26 and reads as long-established, which is a different risk than being false.

legs.name: token benchmark
legs.note: THE SPINE. 'Cost stays flat, even on huge scenes' leads the positioning page and every other differentiator hangs off it. Architecturally sound, numerically unproven. Arm B is computed by serialising a scene - NOT by running a competitor's product, which would be neither fair nor necessary. Cost is NEVER reported without outcome: flat cost on a failed task is not a feature.
